sn16.8:1.2: atha kho āyasmā mahākassapo yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami …pe… ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho āyasmantaṃ mahākassapaṃ bhagavā etadavoca:
sn16.8:1.5: ahaṃ vā kassapa, bhikkhū ovadeyyaṃ tvaṃ vā.
sn16.8:1.6: ahaṃ vā bhikkhūnaṃ dhammiṃ kathaṃ kareyyaṃ, tvaṃ vāti.
sn16.8:2.1: dubbacā kho bhante, etarahi bhikkhū, dovacassakaraṇehi dhammehi samannāgatā, akkhamā, appadakkhiṇaggāhino anusāsaninti.
sn16.8:2.2: tathā hi pana kassapa pubbe therā bhikkhū āraññakā ceva ahesuṃ āraññakattassa ca vaṇṇavādino. piṇḍapātikā ceva ahesuṃ piṇḍapātikattassa ca vaṇṇavādino. paṃsukūlikā ceva ahesuṃ paṃsukūlikattassa ca vaṇṇavādino. tecīvarikā ceva ahesuṃ tecīvarikattassa ca vaṇṇavādino. appicchā ceva ahesuṃ appicchatāya ca vaṇṇavādino. santuṭṭhā ceva ahesuṃ santuṭṭhiyā ca vaṇṇavādino. pavivittā ceva ahesuṃ pavivekassa ca vaṇṇavādino. asaṃsaṭṭhā ceva ahesuṃ asaṃsaggassa ca vaṇṇavādino. āraddhaviriyā ceva ahesuṃ viriyārambhassa ca vaṇṇavādino.
sn16.8:3.1: tatra yo hoti bhikkhu āraññako ceva āraññakattassa ca vaṇṇavādī, piṇḍapātiko ceva piṇḍapātikattassa ca vaṇṇavādī, paṃsukūliko ceva paṃsukūlikattassaca vaṇṇavādī, tecīvariko ceva tecīvarikattassa ca vaṇṇavādī, appiccho ceva appicchatāya ca vaṇṇavādī, santuṭṭho ceva santuṭṭhiyā ca vaṇṇavādī, pavivitto ceva pavivekassa ca vaṇṇavādī, asaṃsaṭṭho ceva asaṃsaggassa ca vaṇṇavādī, āraddhaviriyo ceva viriyārambhassa ca vaṇṇavādī, taṃ therā bhikkhū āsanena nimantenti
sn16.8:3.2: “ehi bhikkhu, ko nāmāyaṃ bhikkhu, bhaddako vatāyaṃ bhikkhu. sikkhākāmo vatāyaṃ bhikkhu, ehi bhikkhu, idaṃ āsanaṃ nisīdāhī”ti.
sn16.8:4.1: tatra kassapa, navānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ evaṃ hohi.
sn16.8:4.2: ‘yo kira so hoti bhikkhu āraññako ceva āraññakattassa ca vaṇṇavādī, piṇḍapātiko ceva …pe… paṃsukūliko ceva …pe… tecīvarikova ceva …pe… appiccho ceva …pe… santuṭṭho ceva …pe… pavivitto ceva …pe… asaṃsaṭṭho ceva …pe… āraddhaviriyo ceva viriyārambhassa ca vaṇṇavādī, taṃ therā bhikkhū āsanena nimantenti
sn16.8:4.3: “ehi bhikkhu ko nāmāyaṃ, bhaddako vatāyaṃ bhikkhu sikkhākāmovatāyaṃ bhikkhu “ehi bhikkhu, idaṃ āsanaṃ nisīdāhīti.
sn16.8:4.5: tesaṃ taṃ hoti dīgharattaṃ hitāya sukhāya.
sn16.8:5.1: etarahi pana kassapa, therā bhikkhū na ceva āraññakā na ca āraññakattassa vaṇṇavādino. na ceva piṇḍapātikā na ca piṇḍapātikattassa vaṇṇavādino. na ceva paṃsukūlikā na ca paṃsukūlikattassa ca vaṇṇavādino. na ceva tecīvarikā na ca tecīvarikattassa vaṇṇavādino. na ceva appicchā na ca appicchatāya ca vaṇṇavādino. na ceva santuṭṭhā na ca santuṭṭhiyā ca vaṇṇavādino. na ceva pavivittā na ca pavivekassa ca vaṇṇavādino. na ceva asaṃsaṭṭhā na ca asaṃsaggassa ca vaṇṇavādino. na ceva āraddhaviriyā na ca viriyārambhassa vaṇṇavādino.
sn16.8:6.1: tatra yo hoti bhikkhu ñāto yasassī lābhī cīvarapiṇḍapātasenāsanagilānapaccayabhesajjaparikkhārānaṃ, taṃ therā bhikkhū āsanena nimantenti
sn16.8:6.2: “ehi bhikkhu, ko nāmāyaṃ bhikkhu, bhaddako vatāyaṃ bhikkhu, sabrahmacārikāmo vatāyaṃ bhikkhu, ehi bhikkhu, idaṃ āsanaṃ, nisīdāhī”ti.
sn16.8:7.1: tatra kassapa navānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ evaṃ hoti:
sn16.8:7.2: “yo kira so hoti bhikkhu ñāto yasassī lābhī cīvarapiṇḍapātasenāsanagilānapaccayabhesajjaparikkhārānaṃ, taṃ therā bhikkhū āsanena nimanteti
sn16.8:7.3: “ehi bhikkhu konāmāyaṃ bhikkhu, bhaddako vatāyaṃ bhikkhu: sabrahmacārikāmo vatāyaṃ bhikkhu, ehi bhikkhu, idaṃ āsanaṃ, nisīdāhīti.
sn16.8:7.5: tesaṃ taṃ hoti dīgharattaṃ ahitāya dukkhāya.
sn16.8:7.6: yaṃ hi taṃ kassapa, sammāvadamāno vadeyya
sn16.8:7.7: upaddutā brahmacārī brahmacārūpaddavena, abhibhavanā brahmacārī brahmacārābhibhavanenāti evaṃhitaṃ kassapa sammāvadanto vadeyya upaddutā brahmacārī brahmacārupaddavena abhibhavanā brahmacārī brahmacārābhibhavanenāti.
